description: Make sounds in a Game kit: each sound gets up to four takes, and each sound made is one generation. Each uses one of the account's plan generations of the day, shared with generate_sound; nothing is charged. Without a plan it answers payment_required with buy_url, and when the day's are used with plans_url: the user chooses a plan on that page (a 24-hour pass for $3.90 (10 sounds), or a plan from $9.90 for 30 days: 50 to 200 generations a day for the whole account), never the agent.

kit_id.description: The kit id from start_game_kit or add_kit_sounds (kit_…).

sound_ids.description: Sounds to make or remake (default: every listed sound not made yet).

name: make_kit_sounds
